senses.gloss:
(ऋ) कवृ r. 1st cl. (कवते)
1 To describe, (as a poet.)
2 To paint, to picture; also कब.

m. (-कः)
1 A mouthful.
2 A fungus, a mushroom, &c.
E.
कु to sound, अक aff.

mn. (-चः-चं)
1 Armour, mail.
2 A drum used in battle, a kettle drum.
3 An amulet, a charm.
4 A tree, (Hibiscus populneoides): see गर्द्दभाण्ड.
5 The mystical syllable Hum, forming part of a Mantra, and considered as a preservative like armour; it is also inscribed on a Birch leaf, &c. and worn as an amulet; being carried about the person as a charm: see the next.
E.
कु to sound, अच् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-त्रं)
The Birch tree, commonly Bhojpatra: see भूर्जपत्र.
E.
कवच an amulet, and पत्र a leaf: see the last.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Wearing armour or amulets.
m. (-रः)
A boy, a child.
E.
कवच, and हृ to take, अच् or ट aff.

f. (-टी)
A door: see कवाट.

f. (-यी)
A kind of flat fish, commonly Kavay or Kay; remarkable for going by land from one spot to another, (Coiuscoboius, HAM.)

sub. mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
A braid or fillet of hair.
adj. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Mixed, intermingled, blended.
2 Set, inlaid.
mn. (-रः-रं)
1 Salt.
2 Sourness or acidity.
f. (-रा or -री)
A plant, (Mimosa octandra.)
(-री)
The leaf of the asafoetida plant, Hingupatri.
E.
क the head, &c. वृ to screen, अच् affix, fem. do. टाप् or ङीष्

m. (-रः)
1 A lotus.
2 A bird, (Tantalus falcinellus, BUC.)
E.
क water, वर to prefer, अण् aff.

n. (-रं)
An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.)
f. (-री)
An umbrella, a Catta, especially one without a stick, and worn like a broad brimmed hat.
E.
क the head, and आबार what covers or protects, from वृ to skreen, and घञ् aff.

f. (-की)
A captive, a prisoner: see वन्दी.

m. (-रः)
A fine head of hair.
E.
कवरी, and भार a load; also कवरीभर.

mfn. (भृत्)
Wearing a fillet of hair.
E.
कवरी, and भृत् who has.

m. (-लः)
1 A mouthful.
2 A kind of fish, commonly Baliya.
3 An astringent wash for cleaning the mouth, a gargle.
E.
क the head, water, &c. and वल to be strong, अच् aff.

f. (-का)
A piece of cloth over a sore, a bandage.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Eaten.
E.
कवल nominal verb, to eat, and क्त aff.

m. (-सः)
Armour, mail.
E.
कु to sound, and अस Uṇādi affix; also कवच.

sub. mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
A door, the leaf or pannel of the door.
E.
क wind, air, वट to exclude, and अण् affix; also कपाट.

n. (-क्रं)
A plant, commonly Kapāta ventu.

mfn. (-विः-विः or -वी-वि)
Learned, wise.
m. (-विः)
1 A poet.
2 The sun.
3 ŚUKRA, the regent of the planet Venus, and preceptor of the demons.
4 A name of VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa, the inventor of poesy.
5 A name of BRAHMĀ.
f. (-विः-वी)
The bit of a bridle, or the reins altogether; also कविका.
E.
कु to sound, to celebrate, and इन् Uṇādi aff.

nf. (-कं-का)
The bit of a bridle, or the reins altogether.
(-का)
A sort of fish, the Kay.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A name of VĀLMĪKI, author of the Rāmāyaṇa.
E.
कवि a poet, and ज्येष्ठ elder or superior.

f. (-ता)
1 Poesy, poetical style or composition.
2 A poem.
E.
कवि, and तल affix; also with त्व affix, कवित्वं.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Wise, learned, a genius, a poet.
E.
कविता poetry, &c. वेदिन् who understands.

mn. (-यः-यं)
The bit of a bridle, or the reins.
E.
कु to sound, affix यः see कवि and कविक.

n. (-यं)
The bit of a bridle, or the reins.
E.
कु to sound, छ affix; also कविय.

m. (-णः)
A name of VĀLMĪKI.
E.
कवि a poet, &c. and रामायण the epic poem so called; the poet of the Rāmāyaṇa.

f. (-का)
A musical instrument, a kind of lute.

m. (-किः)
The poet VĀLMĪKI.

n. (-लं)
A lotus.
E.
क water, विल to send, &c. घञ् aff.

mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं)
Slightly warm, tepid.
n. (-ष्णं)
A slight warmth.
E.
कु indifferent, and उष्ण warm.

n. (-व्यं)
An oblation or offering of food to deceased ancestors.
E.
कु to sound or praise, यत् aff.

m. (-व्यः)
A name of ŚUKRĀCĀRYA, the preceptor of the demons.
f. (-व्या)
1 Understanding, intelligence.
2 A female fiend: see पूतना.
3 A Pitṛ of a particular order, the son of KAVI or ŚUKRA.
n. (-व्यं)
A poem, poetical composition.
E.
कवि a poet, &c. ञ्यत् derivative or pleonastic aff.

m. (-लः)
A class of the manes or deified ancestors.
E.
कव्य an offering to the manes, वा occasionally, and ल who receives.

m. (-नः)
Fire.
E.
कव्य, and वाहन vehicle; also कव्यवाह.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to armour, armorial.
n. (-कं)
A multitude of men in armour.
E.
कवच armour, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Fearful, henpecked.
m. (-कः)
An owl.

m. (-दः)
Indistinct sound.
E.
का for कु bad, वाद speech.

m. (-कः)
1 A gallinaceous fowl.
2 The ruddy goose.
3 A small singing bird, (Loxia philippensis^1): see पीतमस्तक.
E.
क water, or क for कु bad, आङ्, before वृ to cover, and कक् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-रं)
Saffron, (Crocus sativus.)
f. (-री)
1 A river in the Dekhin, the Kāverī.
2 A courtezan, a harlot.
3 Turmeric.
E.
कव to colour, एरक affix, and the radical vowel made long, fem. affix ङीष्.

m. (-रः)
A plagiarist.
E.
काव्य a poem, and चौर a thief.
